column1: # Named negative controls for the embedded-skill tests (ADR-008).
# Each mutant breaks ONE rule in a rendered project; the named test must fail.
# Columns (TAB-separated): id, file (relative to the rendered project), sed expression, test, what it breaks.
# A mutant must touch code both GNU and BSD runs execute — never only one side of a platform branch.

column5: file_mtime always returns 0, so fresh files read as ancient
set_mtime_days_ago leaves the file fresh (both GNU and BSD paths)
count_matches reports 1 for a missing file
backdating sets the author date only (skills read %ct)
stale-branch threshold drifts from 30 to 31 days
CHANGELOG recency threshold drifts from 60 to 63 days
shipped .env.example values are no longer detected
undeclared process.env reads are no longer counted
routes importing storage is no longer a violation
services importing express is no longer a violation
§9 accepts unlabeled compose services
standup window widens from 24 to 72 hours
session-state STALE threshold drifts from 7 to 8 days
stale-TODO threshold drifts from 30 to 31 days
doc-sweep stale-TODO threshold drifts from 30 to 31 days
reflect stops appending the new working-memory decision
feature-intake stops writing the dated working-memory entry
hardcoded credentials stop being rated high
routes importing services is no longer a violation
controllers importing storage is no longer a violation
.env missing from .gitignore is no longer flagged
every populated session-state classifies STALE
every link is reported as orphaned
the SHIPPED session-resume classifier's threshold drifts from 7 to 30 days
skills-doctor stops flagging descriptions without a trigger
§8 accepts an empty phase value
